apps.name: Beacon Admin
apps.whats_new: NEW IN 1.30.0: WORSHIP & MEDIA IS ITS OWN PROGRAM - The Worship & Media page left Beacon Admin: the songs, set lists, devotionals, the worship team, the media team, the Music Leaders, the team check-ins and the team's announcements are in the new program BEACON WORSHIP & MEDIA (for the Music Leader). The schedule stays here: Beacon Admin still makes the activities and their roles, and the worship and media roles are still in every activity.

apps.name: Beacon Worship & Media
apps.whats_new: NEW IN 1.1.0: TWO COMPUTERS, SAFELY - Beacon Worship & Media can now be used on two computers (for example the Music Leader's laptop and the pastor's computer). Online & Sharing → 5: import the Google sign-in file (the same one as Beacon Admin's; on a computer with Beacon Admin it offers that one), click Connect, then Sync Now. The songs, set lists, devotionals and teams then go between the computers through the church's Google Drive (at start, every 10 minutes, before Publish and when closing); when both changed something, the two are combined and nothing is lost. Only ONE open computer at a time does the changes from the Music Leaders' phones and the automatic publish, so nothing is done twice; the other one says which computer does it, and takes over by itself 10 minutes after that one is closed (or at once with "Do the phones' changes on this computer"). A new computer can choose "From the other computer, through Google Drive" at the first start. Also: when the church's website needs a newer Beacon Worship & Media, this program says "Please update" and stops going online until it is updated (so an old copy cannot undo the new one's work); it can sign in with a Beacon Worship & Media account (worship_office) that can do only the worship and media work, not everything of the office. Needs Website Update 106 (rules 57) for the last three; with older rules it works as 1.0 did.
